lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap for Nigeria and compiled by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT). The dataset represents approximately 44% of estimated total buildings based on AI-mapping validation, with an average data age of 5 years and recent updates within the last 6 months. Data are provided in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, GeoJSON, GeoPackage, KML, Garmin IMG) for accessibility across disaster risk assessment workflows.
